en.headline: Court of First Instance judge Alex Lee appointed to Court of Appeal
en.dek: The Chief Executive accepted the Judicial Officers Recommendation Commission’s advice; the appointment of the designated national security judge takes effect on 30 October.
body: The Judiciary announced on Thursday that Court of First Instance judge Alex Lee Wan-tang has been appointed a Justice of Appeal of the High Court.
According to the Judiciary, the Chief Executive accepted the recommendation of the Judicial Officers Recommendation Commission. The appointment takes effect on 30 October.

Lee, born in 1966, obtained his LLB and PCLL from the University of Hong Kong. He was called to the Hong Kong Bar in 1993, served as a prosecutor and later as Senior Assistant Director of Public Prosecutions, was appointed a District Judge in 2013 and a Court of First Instance judge in 2019.

He has been designated to handle national security cases and has sat on panels in proceedings involving Jimmy Lai, the primary election of pro-democracy candidates and the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China.

zh.headline: 原訟庭法官李運騰獲委任為上訴庭法官
zh.dek: 行政長官接納司法人員推薦委員會建議，指定國安法官的任命於10月30日起生效。
body: 司法機構周四宣布，高等法院原訟法庭法官李運騰獲委任為高等法院上訴法庭法官。
司法機構表示，行政長官根據司法人員推薦委員會的推薦作出有關任命，任命於10月30日起生效。
李運騰1966年在香港出生，先後於香港大學取得法學士及法律專業證書。他於1993年獲律師資格，曾出任檢察官及高級助理刑事檢控專員，2013年獲委任為區域法院法官，2019年獲委任為高等法院原訟法庭法官。
他為《國安法》指定法官，曾參與審理涉及黎智英、民主派初選及支聯會等案件的聆訊。
